extracted.name: Kalamata Olive Tapenade
extracted.description: This olive tapenade made with garlic, Kalamata olives, parsley, capers, olive oil, and lemon juice is a deliciously zippy, briny crostini spread.
instruction_lines: Place garlic cloves into a blender or food processor; pulse to mince.
Add olives, parsley, capers, lemon juice, and olive oil. Pulse until finely chopped and combined.
Season with salt and pepper. Transfer tapenade to a serving bowl. Serve immediately, or refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 1 week.
